data.one_liner: A simple, highly customizable analog clock widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable analog clock widget where you can adjust the background, dial, markings, and hands. It supports keeping time or displaying a specific fixed date and time.
use_when: You need to display an analog clock inside your Flutter application.
You want to customize the appearance of clock hands, dials, and markings.
avoid_when: You need a digital clock instead of an analog clock.
strengths: Highly customizable with many styling factors (colors, sizes, lengths).
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on rendering an analog clock.
